Your collection and privacy

PokéSift is a privately operated collection app. When cloud accounts are enabled, Google and Neon handle sign-in. The app receives your account identifier, name and email address, and stores your cards, archived scan photos, provider results, saved prices and arrangements in your private account.

Render hosts the app. Neon hosts cloud collection records and private photo storage. Browser copies support editing through temporary network interruptions. Someone with access to your browser profile or downloaded backup can access those local copies.

Submitting a scan sends the prepared, cropped photo to TCG API. Chinese catalog lookups send saved card identifiers/details to PikaQian. Their retention policies are separate. Browsing, migration and backup do not automatically rescan cards. Provider price data may have contractual retention restrictions.

Photos are private and require an authenticated account to retrieve. A seven-day invitation grants a scan allowance to the recipient's own account; it does not share the sender's collection. Sign-in and invitations do not provide unlimited paid scans.

Cloud-deleted cards are recoverable for 30 days, then become eligible for maintenance cleanup. Original device collections and downloaded backups are not remotely deleted. Signing out removes the cloud account's cached collection on that device after sync or explicit backup confirmation. There are no application analytics or request-body logs.

You can export your collection and archived photos from Account → Back up collection. For account deletion or support, contact the person who invited you; the owner can process deletion through the administrative maintenance tool. Provider backups may retain data until their retention windows expire.

Before cloud accounts are enabled, collections remain in the browser only. Keep complete backups until cloud migration has been verified.

Last updated: 28 October 2026.
